text: A tiny island floating in the sea with a white bunny thing and a heart bubble. It says Day 2 already, and 'Tap an empty tile' with a yellow box highlighted. I'll tap the grass inside the box.
Spent my only 10 coins on a Farm. Whoa, it turned night already - a day is only 30 seconds? The bunny is hammering the farm, 4 sec. Waiting to see it finish.
Sowed seeds, got 1 XP. Now 'tap again to water -- three times in all'. Feels like a cozy farming loop. Tapping the farm to water.
Oops - the bunny (Momo) was standing in the middle of the farm, so my tap picked Momo instead: 'Momo, Free time, Assign'. Night again. I'll tap the farm's edge away from Momo.
Sprouts! Water says '11s left' - maybe a cooldown before the next watering. Now it asks me to 'Tap a Momo'. Tapping the bunny.
Missed - Momo walked away and I tapped water, which showed an expansion plot for $35 (not enough money). So the island can grow! Trying to tap Momo again where it is now.
Got Momo selected. Crops grew big. Hint: 'Its tiles light up. The pencil edits them' - not sure which tiles; I don't see anything lit. Pencil icon is highlighted, so I'll tap it.
Hmm, tapping the pencil just took me back to 'Tap a Momo'. Did nothing visible. A bit confusing. Momo is standing still now, tapping it.

Frustrating: Momo keeps wandering, so by the time I tap the pencil it has moved and I hit the sea (expansion $35 popup again). The tutorial loops back to 'Tap a Momo'. But tomatoes are ripe! I have 0 coins, so harvesting feels more important. Tapping the farm.

Finally got the pencil! Harvest gave +$5 and XP jumped to 29. Now: 'Tap tiles or drag across them 0/4'. I guess I'm choosing which tiles Momo works on. Island looks like 4 tiles. Tapping the farm tile.
Momo is now 'Working at Farm' with a numbered route (1). A big tips box popped up explaining watering cooldown and demolishing. Lots of text at once. Tapping Got it.
Confirmed. Momo now 'Working at Farm, 1 jobs' - so it should farm on its own now? I have $5, not enough for another farm ($10). Let me peek at the Mailbox - maybe free stuff.
Mailbox empty. Shop sells one thing: 'Hire Momo $25'. So more bunnies = more workers. Goal forming: save money -> more farms / more Momos. Checking Research.

Research: a big tech tree - Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 0/3 flasks + $20. I have no flasks - probably from the Research lab that opens at Lv2. Nice long-term goals. Closing, checking Status.

Status page: my island is 'Momonium', a Village. To become a City: Land 4/9, Momo 1/3, Research 0/3, Value $5/$1.5K. That's a clear big goal. $1.5K feels far when a harvest gives $5. Closing to go make money.

Momo harvested on its own (XP 33->53) but coins stayed at 5 - where did the crops go? I see a cut-off '1 c...' at the right edge under the XP bar. Also a letter bubble over Momo and a red dot on Mailbox! Opening mail.

Aww, a letter from Momo proposing to widen the field - cute, Momo has its own ideas. Coins went to 10 (the money arrived a while after harvest). Let me see what 'Let's research it' does - I think I lack the flasks.
It's now 'On the research list'. OK. With $10 I'll build a second farm so money comes faster. Closing mail and tapping the empty left tile.
Second farm under construction on the left tile, back to 0 coins. Plan: once built, add it to Momo's route with the pencil so Momo tends both.
New farm built and I can sow it myself with the Sow button - so I'm a worker too, alongside Momo. Now I want Momo to include this farm in its route. Tapping Momo.
Route now 1 -> 2, two farms. Momo got 'Farm skill 1', nice little growth. Confirming, then reading the new mail.

Another Momo letter: water less often (mulch/straw). These letters are charming - they make the upgrade feel like Momo's idea. Adding it to research list. XP 86/100, almost Lv 2 which unlocks the Research lab and Lumberyard.
Momo walked onto the farm I wanted, so the Momo panel stays. It's hard to tap a farm when Momo stands on it. Trying the other (top) farm.
Ha, it looks like when Momo is selected, tapping a farm sends Momo there instead of selecting the farm. Not sure if that's what's happening. I'll just let the two farms run and watch the coins.
Level 2! Quiet level-up though - I almost missed it. But coins are stuck at 5 even after harvests; I don't understand when crops turn into money. Let me see what the Research lab costs now.
+$5, now $10. Lv2 prices: Research lab $45, Lumberyard $80, Farm $10. Curious about the star 'Special 0/1' - tapping it to see what it is.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6). A Momo Monument, lol. Something to look forward to. Going back to build a 3rd farm with my $10.
Third farm going up on the right tile. Island is filling up - 3 of 4 tiles. Next I'd want to save $45 for the Research lab so Momo's letter ideas can actually be researched.

Sowing farm 3 myself, seeds flying in. Three plots of crops at different stages - it looks lovely at night. Feels relaxing, but money is very slow ($5 at a time) and I still don't get when harvests pay out.
